L71@P2: Further, the Government in Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI) has
L72@P2: implemented following Schemes, to promote Electric vehicle
L73@P2: adoption, on a pan-India basis Including the State of Tamil Nadu : -
L74@P2: (i) Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of (Hybrid &) Electric Vehicles
L75@P2: in India (FAME India) Scheme Phase-II: The Government
L76@P2: implemented this scheme for a period of five years from 01.04.2019
L77@P2: to 31.03.2024 with a total budgetary support of Rs.11,500 crore. The
L78@P2: scheme provided demand incentive for e-2Ws, e-3Ws, e-4Ws and
L79@P2: grant for e-buses and setting up of EV public charging stations (EV
L80@P2: PCS). FAME-II has supported the sale of approximately 16.71 lakh
L81@P2: electric vehicles including e-2Ws, e-3Ws and e-4Ws and 6,862 ebuses were sanctioned for various cities out of which 5,195 e-buses
L82@P2: have been deployed as on 07.02.2026.
L83@P2: (ii) Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and
L84@P2: Auto Component
L85@P2: Industry in India (PLI-Auto): The Government notified this scheme
L86@P2: for Automobile and Auto Component Industry in India, on
L87@P2: 23.09.2021, for enhancing India's manufacturing capabilities for
L88@P2: Advanced Automotive Technology (AAT) products, including EVs,
L89@P2: with a budgetary outlay of Rs.25,938 crore.
L90@P2: (iii) Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for National
L91@P2: Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage : The
L92@P2: Government on 09.06.2021 notified the PLI Scheme for
L93@P2-3: manufacturing of ACC in the country with a budgetary outlay of Rs.18,100 crore. The scheme aims to establish a competitive
L94@P3: domestic manufacturing ecosystem for 50 GWh of ACC batteries.
L95@P3: (iv) PM Electric Drive Revolution in Innovative Vehicle Enhancement
L96@P3: (PM EDRIVE) Scheme: This scheme with an outlay of Rs.10,900 crore
L97@P3: has been notified on 29.09.2024. This scheme supports
L98@P3: incentivization of approximately 28.27 lakh electric vehicles (EVs)
L99@P3: including e- 2W, e-3W, e-Trucks, e-buses and e-Ambulances. Further,
L100@P3: EV public charging stations (EV PCS) and upgradation of testing
L101@P3: agencies is also included in this scheme. An allocation of Rs.4,391
L102@P3: crore has been made under the scheme for deployment of 14,028 ebuses out of which 13,800 e-buses have been allocated among
L103@P3: seven cities having four million plus population namely Delhi,
L104@P3: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Pune and Surat.
L105@P3: (v) PM e-Bus Sewa-Payment Security Mechanism (PSM) Scheme:
L106@P3: This Scheme notified on 28.10.2024, has an outlay of Rs.3,435.33
L107@P3: crore and aims to support deployment of more than 38,000 electric
L108@P3: buses. The objective of this scheme is to provide payment security
L109@P3: to e-bus operators in case of default by Public Transport Authorities
L110@P3: (PTAs).
L111@P3: (vi) Scheme for Promotion of Manufacturing of Electric Passenger
L112@P3: Cars in India (SPMEPCI) was notified on 15th March, 2024 to
L113@P3: promote the manufacturing of electric cars in India. This requires
L114@P3: applicants to invest a minimum of Rs.4,150 crore and to achieve a
L115@P3: minimum DVA of 25% at the end of the third year and DVA of 50% at
L116@P3-4: the end of the fifth year.ANNEXURE I
